[*] Fixed Ancient Flag item text

notes.title: v1.01 Hotfix
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fixed The S of WASD not working properly
[*] Doubled vertical movement speed
[*] Increased player movement speed at some points in the game, especially in larger battles
[*] Fixed possible item softlocks, especially in Mirikmar
[*] Fixed a softlock at the end of the game
[*] Slightly lowered the volume of Mi battle voices
[/olist]
